desc: Parse input: read N, M, X and the M edges; build adjacency list `out0` (original) and `out1` (reversed).
Implement Dijkstra over states encoded as `v * 2 + o` (or a 2D dist array), initializing dist[1][0] = 0 and pushing it into a min-heap.
On popping state (v, o) with distance d: skip if stale; relax moves along out[o][v] with cost 1 to (u, o), and relax the flip to (v, 1-o) with cost X.
Stop early when the target state (N, 0) or (N, 1) is popped with the minimal distance, or compute full distances and take the minimum of the two.
Print the answer as an integer to stdout, ensuring fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer) for up to 2×10^5 edges.
Verify logic against the provided samples mentally (e.g., sample 2 uses one flip costing 1 plus two moves) and check edge cases like X larger than any path cost.
